data.text: Good to see everyone. My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next season, and I’d like us to keep this lake supporting the village. With 100 tons now, we can each catch 10 tons this month, leave 50, and let the lake replenish to 100. That’s $10,000 each, with the same opportunity next month if we stick to it. Can we agree on that limit and check our catches together each month? John, what do you think?
